pilot.monthlyLimitLine: We run a limited number of pilots each month, because each one uses a real person’s real time. If we are full, we will tell you when the next slot is.

professionalStandardsSignOff.note: The client decided on 23 August to publish without a sign-off on file, so the [CONFIRM WITH US CPA] markers no longer render. CO-10 recommended one. The copy is hedged - it opens by saying it is a summary, not legal advice, and to confirm your own position with your adviser or state board - and that hedge is what makes publishing it defensible. Getting a CPA to read it remains worth doing; it is now a recommendation rather than a launch blocker.
